name: agent-gitu
description: Agent Gitu: an autonomous engineering agent with project guard, task ledger, evidence gates, specialist sub-agents, in-app browser and an animated voxel mascot

scripts.test:fast: vitest run --exclude tests/agent-evals/** --exclude tests/reliability-*.test.ts --exclude tests/hermes.test.ts --exclude tests/server.test.ts --exclude tests/subagent*.test.ts --exclude tests/browser.test.ts --exclude tests/lsp.test.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json package-lock.json README.md eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json .github src/agent/quality-metrics.ts src/cli/presenter.ts src/cli.ts src/context/change-signals.ts src/context/code-index.ts src/context/context-engine.ts src/evaluation/metrics.ts src/report/reporter.ts src/server/static-assets.ts scripts/eval-summary.ts tests/change-signals.test.ts tests/cli-presenter.test.ts tests/code-index.test.ts tests/context-engine.test.ts tests/evaluation-metrics.test.ts tests/quality-metrics.test.ts tests/static-assets.test.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json package-lock.json README.md eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json .github src/agent/quality-metrics.ts src/cli/presenter.ts src/cli.ts src/context/change-signals.ts src/context/code-index.ts src/context/context-engine.ts src/evaluation/metrics.ts src/report/reporter.ts src/server/static-assets.ts scripts/eval-summary.ts tests/change-signals.test.ts tests/cli-presenter.test.ts tests/code-index.test.ts tests/context-engine.test.ts tests/evaluation-metrics.test.ts tests/quality-metrics.test.ts tests/static-assets.test.ts
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:fast && npm run build
scripts.dist: npm run generate:brand-icons && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
